notes.title: 🏷️ Steam Spring Sale 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Over the past months, we've been hard at work making Zombie Raid better than ever. We've improved the network code for smoother gameplay, added new weapons and vehicles, and fine-tuned the ballistics system for more responsive shooting.

But that’s not all! We've introduced weapon upgrades, new skins, and improved game mechanics to make every match more intense and strategic. Horde mode has also seen refinements, making survival more thrilling than ever!

While there's still much to do, we’re getting closer to the full release with each update. Your support means the world to us—join the battle, leave feedback, and help shape the future of Zombie Raid!

🔥 Spring Sale – Get In Now! 🔥[/h3]

[h3]Work on local servers is complete!  
Now you can create your own Lobby 🖥️ with a variety of individual settings.  
The server now runs on the computer of the lobby leader, and for better performance, it is recommended that the leader be the player with the most powerful computer.  
This will allow for better performance and fewer lags!  
Additionally, the Lobby can be private, so you can play only with those you want.  
Thank you for your patience and support! Stay tuned![/h3]

notes.title: 🔔 UPDATE! [6]
notes.content:
[h2]We have switched to Unreal Engine 5![/h2]
[h3]
Yes, it wasn't easy: we had to transfer all the mechanics, and it took quite a bit of time.
Because of this, the main work on the game was paused. But now the biggest crash is behind us ),
and fighting with the ones that will appear will be much easier.
Additionally, the game has become more stable, and FPS on DirectX 12 has noticeably improved.
[/h3]
[h2]📋 CHANGELOG[/h2]
[h3][b]GENERAL:[/b][/h3]
[h3][list]
[*] Migrated the game to Unreal Engine 5.4, introducing enhanced graphics, performance improvements, and better tool compatibility.
[*] Stability and performance updates to ensure smoother gameplay and reduce crashes.
[*] Improved memory handling to address random corruption issues and enhance overall reliability.
[*] Refined matchmaking to prevent session duplication and improve the multiplayer experience.
[*] Adjusted lighting, navigation meshes, and collision settings across multiple levels for better gameplay flow and visuals.
[/list][/h3]
[h3][b]ADDED:[/b][/h3]
[h3][list]
[*] Push Model replication for ammo consumption, ensuring smoother and more stable reloading during client-side shooting.
[/list][/h3]
[h3][b]REMOVED:[/b][/h3]
[h3][list]
[*] Redundant checks for gas zombies that were preventing proper spawn behavior.
[*] Particle system components causing crashes and instability.
[/list][/h3]
[h3][b]CHANGED:[/b][/h3]
[h3][list]
[h3][b]Zombies:[/b][/h3]
[*] Improved zombie AI pathfinding, including better handling of long paths and obstacles.
[*] Refined zombie capsule size to improve navigation in narrow areas.
[*] Adjusted zombie spawning mechanics to avoid barricades and problematic areas.
[*] Delayed aggression updates during navigation mesh recalculations to prevent conflicts.
[h3][b]Combat:[/b][/h3]
[*] Updated friendly fire mechanics: all sources now deal 100% damage except projectiles, which deal 20%.
[*] Fixed reload mechanics to allow cancellation only when enabled by the weapon.
[*] Improved grenade bounce sound and spawn location accuracy.
[h3][b]Visuals:[/b][/h3]
[*] Minor fixes to lighting and shadow issues in various areas.
[h3][b]UI:[/b][/h3]
[*] Resolved minor UI bugs, including those related to final score display, perk levels, and other elements.
[*] Disabled aim-assist widget display in smoke for a more realistic and immersive smoke effect.
[h3][b]Levels:[/b][/h3]
[*] Made changes to object placements to reduce instances where zombies could become stuck.
[/list][/h3]
[h2]Thank you for your patience and support! Stay tuned![/h2]

notes.title: 📢 Early Access
notes.content:
[h3]Today we are launching in Early Access, it's a chance for our team to get additional resources for development.
For those of you who have been playing for the last month, THANK YOU! Your participation has been an important support and help for us lately! 
Now the game is not finished yet, we tried very hard to make everything high quality and decent and it takes time and resources.
We read your feedback, pointing out our problems and also and hope that you will give us a chance to solve them).
Also we realized that we have not been paying enough attention to the Coop / PvE direction, and we plan to fix that.

Thank you very much!
Development Team.

Sorry for the late ANNOUNCEMENT ), I didn't have enough time for it.[/h3]

notes.title: 🎮 HORDE mode is available for testing.
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings! [/h2]
[h3]With the latest update added "HORDE" mode for testing.[/h3]
The goal is to hold out as long as possible and not let a horde of zombies destroy the radio station.
You can play solo, but it is better to call your friends!
The mode is not yet visually designed, but we will fix it soon. 

[h3]Also added BOTs. [/h3]
[b]"SQUAD COMBAT"[/b] mode you can start playing alone and wait for other players to come in.
[b]"DEATHMATCH"[/b] now will not be boring - with a small number of players will also be automatically added bots. 

[h3]Feedback and suggestions write to [url=https://discord.com/invite/grsjdzA][b]DISCORD[/b][/url][/h3]
